name: return-youtube-subscribers
description: Brings back exact, unabbreviated subscriber counts on YouTube.

scripts.lint: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --self-hosted=false && node --check src/main.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && git diff --exit-code -- userscript.js return-youtube-subscribers.user.js store/listings
scripts.start:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --start-url https://www.youtube.com/@YouTube
scripts.start:chrome: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome --start-url https://www.youtube.com/@YouTube
scripts.version: node scripts/build.mjs && git add userscript.js return-youtube-subscribers.user.js store/listings
